# Copilot Instructions for my-first-repo

This repository serves as a learning and demonstration project.

## Project Overview

This is a starter repository that can be used as a template or learning resource.

## Development Guidelines

### Code Style
- Follow standard coding conventions for the language being used
- Keep code simple and readable
- Add comments where necessary to explain complex logic

### Testing
- Write tests for new features when applicable
- Ensure existing tests pass before submitting changes

### Documentation
- Update README.md when adding significant features
- Document any setup or installation steps
- Keep documentation clear and concise

## Best Practices
- Make small, focused commits with clear messages
- Review changes before committing
- Keep the repository organized and clean
